oracle_atoms.business_invariant: The inventory desk owns the daily exception review before supplier outreach.
oracle_atoms.observable_assertion: Every flagged stock exception appears in one daily review queue with an owner acknowledgement state.

business_proxy_facts.answer_text: The inventory desk owns the daily stock-exception review.

canonical_business.root_problem: Inventory desk coordinators miss daily stock exceptions because counts are split across exports and chat, causing delayed supplier follow-up and repeated reconciliation work.

user_profile.scenario: reviewing stock exceptions each morning before supplier follow-up
user_profile.current_workaround: compare a daily export with chat acknowledgements
user_profile.workaround_cost: 4 missed stock exceptions per week and repeated reconciliation work

business_goals: reduce missed stock exceptions from 4 per week to zero during the first 30-day observation window
make daily exception ownership visible before supplier outreach

appetite.complexity_ceiling: reuse the daily inventory export and owner directory
appetite.trim_first: supplier messaging, reorder policy changes, and analytics

scope_boundaries: identify stock exceptions from the daily inventory export

feasibility_constraints.constraint: the inventory export is available once per business day
feasibility_constraints.handling: limit the phase to daily visibility

risks_and_unknowns.impact: the cadence bounds the phase baseline
risks_and_unknowns.mitigation: return to scope review if the cadence changes

decision_rationale.decision: start with a daily exception queue
decision_rationale.rationale: this closes the missed-review loop before automation
decision_rationale.excluded_options: supplier messaging, reorder policy changes, and analytics

delivery_plan.goal: deliver a daily stock-exception review baseline

canonical_business.phase_goal: deliver a daily stock-exception review baseline
entry_conditions: the inventory desk owns the daily exception review
the daily inventory export remains available
exit_conditions: the inventory desk can review every flagged exception in one daily queue
the inventory desk can see owner acknowledgement for every exception
weekly reconciliation can count missed reviews from queue evidence
